versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Pantry Moth Eliminator.
- Generates a step-by-step elimination protocol for Indian meal moth infestations, including exact timelines.
- Features item-by-item disposition (freeze, toss, heat) for all pantry goods.
- Calculates pheromone trap placement and monitoring schedules.
- Includes deep cabinet crack-cleaning instructions and re-infestation watch with moth-free date projections.
- Command-line quick start and verification checklist provided.
